verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented dashboard or report showing dispute rate, false-positive rate, approval-rate lift or review workload, and no export capability. The only mention of reporting is narrower: 'better reporting on agentic traffic'. The marketing lines about increasing approvals and reducing chargebacks describe outcomes, not a metrics view a finance lead can export.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can see the numbers that matter — dispute rate, false-positive rate, approval-rate lift, review workload — and export them for the board
